name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a services agreement governing the provider's AI services, including use of customer input and output, usage restrictions, and limits on training models with customer data.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, support, fees, confidentiality, warranties, and liability.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Data protection terms governing a provider's processing of customer personal data as a processor or subprocessor, including GDPR and UK international transfer mechanisms.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement giving an early design partner access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in the provider's development program.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard terms of a mutual NDA allowing both parties to share and protect confidential information in connection with a stated purpose.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA where the parties fill in the purpose, effective date, term, governing law, and other variables, and sign.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard terms for a business partnership between two companies, covering each party's obligations, feedback, trademark use, confidentiality, and liability.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Terms for a limited trial or pilot that lets a customer access and evaluate a product before committing to a full purchase.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services under statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, fees, IP ownership, and liability.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Uptime and support response commitments for a cloud service, with service credits as a remedy; designed to be used with the Cloud Service Agreement.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing installable (on-premise) software to a customer, covering license scope, permitted uses, support, fees, and liability.
